reuse.why: Changes the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper and routes every inline midpoint copy (template, forecast, action sync, posting, preview) through it.

duplication.why: Removes five inline copies of the missing/number/range dispatch, leaving a single definition.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, which already owned getScheduledAmount and is used by both server and client.

scope.why: Only the rule, the call sites that applied it, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: One definition of the expected amount of a ranged schedule; future rule changes touch one function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites now call getScheduledAmount; no remaining inline range arithmetic for the posted amount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains; the copies were removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, now called by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the existing client callers.
